Recruitment Overview

Exciting Opportunity: HPSC invites applications for 1672 PGT Computer Science posts. The online registration process commences on February 16, 2026, and concludes on March 9, 2026. Applicants can modify their forms as per the official timeline. Stay tuned for the exam schedule, answer key, and admit card release on the official portal. Don't miss this chance to join Haryana's esteemed education sector - apply now and take the first step towards a rewarding career as a Post Graduate Teacher in Computer Science.
